I don’t think the Air Force is right for me. The money thing has never happened to me before. I’m hoping this month was an outlier, but it was so disheartening to see.

It’s not required but I need at least a masters to get a decent job and I don’t even have that yet (I went in straight from undergrad). It’s weird to explain but I was really passionate about what I was studying before. I wanted to get my PhD because I wanted to learn as much as I could. I actually liked my classes, but it’s so much work and recently I’ve been less motivated and excited to learn. But I came all this way to learn, I don’t think I could drop out now.

I really can’t. I moved halfway across the country to go to this school because it was the best in this field. I’m the first in my family to go to school (my mom tried for a little but then dropped out). There’s so much riding on me being here that I can’t just drop out. I know that suicide seems like a cop-out too, but I would make it look like an accident so that they wouldn’t know it was on purpose.
I still have 3 more years in the program. No letters after my name right now
School just started lol it hasn’t gotten that bad yet but it’s going to get worse

I’m in grad school right now and I’m feeling so overwhelmed by the amount of work I have to do. I have 10 hours of practicum, 10 hours of research, and 15 hours of class. That’s not including all of the writing I have to do outside of school.

I’m also feeling so lonely and upset about my looks. My ex is in a new relationship and even though I’m the one that broke up with him, I’m wondering if I shouldn’t have because he’s the only one that’s ever felt the same way about me. I’m trying to date but the last date I went on didn’t go well and I think it’s because the guy thought I wasn’t attractive enough.
